name: uncertainty
quote: I'm not sure what's going to happen next.
description: A sense that you're not able to predict the likelihood or desirability of outcomes in a given situation.
perceptions: Even if I know all the relevant information, I don't trust my ability to explain or predict an outcome.
examples: I don't know when the dog will stop barking.
He doesn't know what time he'll arrive.

comparisons.description: Being uncertain doesn't necessarily mean you predict a negative outcome. For example, you could be optimistically uncertain about whether you're going to miss the train.

commentaries.quote: I can live with doubt and uncertainty and not knowing. I think it is much more interesting to live not knowing than to have answers that might be wrong.
Fear is often our immediate response to uncertainty.
Uncertainty is a sign of humility, and humility is just the ability or the willingness to learn.
Uncertainty is the worst of all evils until the moment when reality makes us regret uncertainty.
